request: Monthly forecast of Tito's vodka bottles in Polk County for the next 5 months

spec.title: Tito's Vodka, Polk County, next 5 months

sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date AS month,
       'total' AS series,
       SUM(il.sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = il.store_no
WHERE il.item_no IN (
    SELECT i.item_no FROM sales.item i
    JOIN sales.item h ON h.item_no = i.family_item_no
    WHERE h.item_desc ILIKE '%TITO%' AND h.item_desc ILIKE '%VODKA%'
)
AND s.county_fips = '19153'
AND il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
assumptions: Tito's Vodka identified as all products whose family item description contains both 'TITO' and 'VODKA' (covers all sizes: 50ml mini, 100ml, 200ml, 375ml, 750ml, 1000ml, 1750ml, and mini 4-pack)
Polk County identified by county_fips 19153, based on store location
Measure is total bottles sold (sales_bottles), which accounts for mini packs correctly
History included from 2016-01-01 through the latest available data; incomplete current month will be dropped by downstream processing
Forecast horizon is 5 months as requested

request: How many bottles of each Tito's mini item will sell statewide over the next 6 months?

spec.title: Tito's mini items, statewide, next 6 months

sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_on)::date AS month,
  CASE WHEN il.item_no IN (SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE family_item_no='38194') THEN 'Tito''s Mini (5pk)' ELSE 'Tito''s Mini 4 Pack' END AS series,
  SUM(sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
WHERE il.item_no IN (SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE family_item_no IN ('38194','38185'))
  AND ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
assumptions: Tito's mini products map to two distinct current item families: item_no 38194 (TITOS HANDMADE VODKA MINI, sold as 50ml 5-packs) and item_no 38185 (TITOS HANDMADE VODKA MINI 4 PACK), each tracked across all historical renumberings via family_item_no.
Measure is bottles sold (sales_bottles), which already accounts for multi-packs as individual bottle counts.
History covers all available data from 2016-01-01 through the latest available month; the current incomplete month is dropped by downstream processing.
Forecast horizon is 6 months as requested, produced separately for each of the two mini item series.

request: American vodka sales dollars for each of the five largest counties, next 6 months

spec.title: American Vodka, dollars, top 5 counties, next 6 months

region.label: Polk, Linn, Scott, Johnson, Black Hawk counties

sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date AS month,
       s.county_name AS series,
       SUM(il.sales_dollars) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = il.store_no
WHERE il.item_no IN (
        SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE category_current = '1031100'
      )
  AND s.county_name IN ('POLK','LINN','SCOTT','JOHNSON','BLACK HAWK')
  AND il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

Largest counties determined by total historical American vodka sales dollars (Polk, Linn, Scott, Johnson, Black Hawk)
Product category assigned using each item's current category (category_current) per warehouse rules, not the category recorded on the order line
